name: Hakufa
title: Ancestor of a Nethinim family
summary: Hakufa was the ancestor of one of the Nethinim families (temple servants) who returned from the Babylonian exile to Jerusalem. His descendants are mentioned among the temple servants in the lists of returnees in the books of Ezra and Nehemiah.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned among the Nethinim families in the book of Ezra
keyEvents.description: Hakufa's descendants are listed among the Nethinim families (the temple servants) who returned from Babylon to Jerusalem under Zerubbabel's leadership.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned among the Nethinim families in the book of Nehemiah
keyEvents.description: Hakufa's descendants are again mentioned in Nehemiah's parallel list of those who returned from exile.

keyEvents.title: The return of the temple servants to Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: The Nethinim families, including Hakufa's descendants, resumed their service at the temple in Jerusalem after returning from the Babylonian exile.

keyEvents.title: Registration of returning families
keyEvents.description: Nehemiah found the genealogical records of those who had first returned, and Hakufa's family was registered among the temple servants.
